summary: Mobile UX Audit for iPhone (390x844) and Samsung (360x800) viewports. Tested Home, Login, Wallet, More, Pool, Merchant, Admin, and All Services pages. Found CRITICAL cookie banner overlap with bottom nav (77px overlap). No horizontal overflow issues detected on any page.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Cookie banner overlaps bottom nav by 77px on iPhone 390x844 viewport. Cookie banner bottom=844px, Bottom nav top=767px. This makes bottom nav buttons partially obscured by the cookie banner.

issues: Cookie banner covers bottom navigation on first visit until user accepts cookies
Card 1 on home page may be narrow (83.5px width) - minor readability concern

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Cookie banner overlaps bottom nav by 77px on mobile. The CSS variable --app-cookie-banner-offset is defined but the cookie banner's paddingBottom calculation may not be working correctly. Consider increasing the offset or adjusting the cookie banner position to sit above the bottom nav.

Review CookieBanner.jsx line 91-96: The paddingBottom uses 'max(0.75rem, var(--app-cookie-banner-offset, calc(5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))))' but this doesn't account for the actual bottom nav height properly on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: CookieBanner.jsx: The CSS variable --app-cookie-banner-offset is set to calc(var(--app-bottom-nav-offset) + 0.5rem) in App.css, but the cookie banner uses a fallback of calc(5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) which is insufficient. The bottom nav is ~77px tall and the cookie banner needs to be positioned above it.
The cookie banner z-index (10000) is higher than bottom nav z-index (9999), so the cookie banner renders on top of the bottom nav, obscuring the navigation buttons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile UX audit completed. Critical issue: Cookie banner overlaps bottom nav by 77px on iPhone viewport. No horizontal overflow issues found. Admin login works with admin@bidblitz.ae / BidBlitz2026!. All pages load correctly on mobile viewports.
